facts.text: W Nashville is in Nashville's Gulch neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: Taking center stage in Nashville's vibrant Gulch neighborhood

facts.text: The hotel is moments from Broadway, Music Row, 12 South, SoBro, Midtown and the Arts District.
facts.excerpt: Just moments from Broadway, Music Row, 12 South, SoBro, Midtown, and the Arts District

facts.text: Lower Broadway is about a 15-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: When you want to venture out to Lower Broadway, you’re an easy 15-minute walk away.

facts.text: The hotel's aesthetic was developed by the Rockwell Group.
facts.excerpt: aesthetic was developed by the renowned Rockwell Group.

facts.text: Every room has a hint of the retro jet-age, with sleek lines and pronounced curves.
facts.excerpt: Every room has a hint of the retro jet-age, with sleek lines complementing pronounced curves.

facts.text: An edition of FAILE's Southern Skies hangs in every guest room.
facts.excerpt: An edition of FAILE’s “Southern Skies” hangs in every guest room at W Nashville.

facts.text: The hotel has custom elevator panels by Nashville leatherworker Joey Verzilli.
facts.excerpt: custom elevator panels by the Nashvillian leatherworker Joey Verzilli

facts.text: The rooftop has views of the Batman Building and Downtown Nashville.
facts.excerpt: From our rooftop, enjoy views of the iconic “Batman Building” and Downtown Nashville.

facts.text: Kelsey Montague's What Lifts You wings mural is also featured on the hotel's southern exterior.
facts.excerpt: wings mural by Kelsey Montague, also featured on our southern exterior.

facts.text: The Spanish Steps connect the WET Deck to the second floor, where the FIT gym and Yoga Lawn are.
facts.excerpt: Connecting the WET Deck to the 2nd floor, where you’ll find our FIT (Gym), Yoga Lawn, and more

facts.text: Live musicians sometimes play on the Spanish Steps.
facts.excerpt: you might even catch a live musician serenading the stars.

facts.text: The Den is a retreat in the Welcome area reserved for suite guests with key-card access.
facts.excerpt: The Den is an exclusive retreat within our Welcome area, reserved for suite guests with key-card access.

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has a large living room, a kitchen and a wet bar.
facts.excerpt: complete with a large living room, a table to gather, a kitchen and wet bar.

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite bedroom has a soaking tub, dual vanities and a rain shower.
facts.excerpt: retire to a separate bedroom with a soaking tub, dual vanities and rain shower.

facts.text: Premier Suites have views over the WET Deck.
facts.excerpt: With ample natural light and views over the WET Deck

facts.text: Guest rooms have a mirrored bar outfitted with what is needed to mix a cocktail.
facts.excerpt: a mirrored bar (above the mini bar) outfitted with whatever is needed to mix a cocktail

facts.text: Jose Andres has launched Zaytinya, Bar Mar and Butterfly at W Nashville.
facts.excerpt: has launched several of his celebrated concepts at W Nashville—Zaytinya, Bar Mar, and Butterfly.

facts.text: Butterfly is a rooftop cocktail lounge with panoramic views of The Gulch.
facts.excerpt: Butterfly at W Nashville pairs panoramic views of The Gulch

facts.text: FIT has Peloton bikes logged in under the hotel's house account.
facts.excerpt: We also have Peloton bikes logged in under our house account.

facts.text: FIT offers fitness classes led by local instructors, from yoga to movement seminars.
facts.excerpt: FIT offers fitness classes led by local instructors, ranging from yoga sessions to movement seminars.

facts.text: The hotel has an in-house boutique with luxury and local finds.
facts.excerpt: our in-house boutique—just steps from the Living Room—offers a curated mix of luxury and local finds

facts.text: Through the P.A.W. program the hotel offers pet beds, bowls and toys.
facts.excerpt: Through our P.A.W. program, we offer pet beds, food and water bowls, bone packs, waste removal bags, litter boxes, and a selection of toys

facts.text: W Nashville draws a young crowd.
facts.excerpt: makes for a young crowd at The W.

facts.excerpt: The streets of the Gulch are lined with restaurants, bars, boutiques, and Nashville’s largest collection of outdoor murals.
